title: Lindnor Backdoor and Glut of Security Killers Used in Ransomware Attack on U.S. Org
content_md: Attackers using the Anubis ransomware deployed a new custom backdoor and a large set of Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver (BYOVD) tools, but attack was thwarted before encryption phase could begin. Article Link: https://www.security.com/threat-intelligence/lindnor-new-backdoor-anubis-ransomware
